E2-2019-T3-P1-S3.trunk: S+V+O：Congress has obstructed efforts（国会阻挠了相关努力）
structure: └ 不定式作后置定语：to create a more straightforward visa
├ 介词短语作后置定语：for agricultural workers
└ 定语从句(that，修饰 visa)：that would let foreign workers stay longer in the U.S. and change jobs within the industry
E2-2019-T3-P1-S3.logic: 不定式说明 efforts 的目标，that 从句继续说明这种签证能够赋予外国工人的两项并列便利。
notes: obstruct efforts to do：阻挠做某事的努力。
straightforward 在此指程序直接、简明。
let somebody do 中不定式不带 to。

E2-2019-T3-P1-S7.trunk: S+系动词+并列表语：Today's farm laborers are more likely to be settled and more likely to be married（如今的农业劳工更可能定居且已婚）
structure: ├ 让步插入语：while still predominantly born in Mexico
├ 表语①：are more likely to be settled rather than migrating
└ 并列表语②：and more likely to be married than single
E2-2019-T3-P1-S7.logic: while 插入语保留劳工来源未变这一背景，两个 more likely 对称比较，突出迁移方式和婚姻状态的变化。
notes: settled rather than migrating：定居而非迁徙。
more likely to... than... 表示相对可能性。

E2-2019-T3-P1-S18.trunk: S+V+O：The H-2A visa has no numerical cap（H-2A签证没有数量上限）
structure: 主句：The H-2A visa has no numerical cap
└ 比较插入语：unlike the H-2B visa for nonagricultural work
└ 非限制性定语从句(which)：which is limited to 66,000 a year
E2-2019-T3-P1-S18.logic: 主句陈述H-2A无上限，unlike 引入H-2B作对比，which 从句给出后者的具体年度限额。
